steps.title: Enhance Image Preprocessing Pipeline
steps.description: Added grayscale conversion, contrast boosting, adaptive thresholding, sharpening filters, and multi-angle rotation correction for box label processing.

steps.title: Implement Multi-Directional Text Label Detector
steps.description: Added proximity-based text extraction support for labels appearing before, after, above, or below target values on box packaging.

steps.title: Expand Model and Device Identifier Pattern Matchers
steps.description: Implemented flexible regex label matchers for Model No, Model Number, Device Model, Model Name, and Type variations.

steps.title: Implement Flexible IMEI 1 and IMEI 2 Label Extraction
steps.description: Added label detection for IMEI 1, IMEI 2, IMEI Slot 1/2, IMEI-1/2, and dual-slot packaging layouts.

steps.title: Add Robust OCR Digit Correction and Luhn IMEI Validation
steps.description: Added digit substitution fixes for common OCR misreadings (O->0, I->1, S->5) and strict 15-digit Luhn checksum verification.

steps.title: Implement Serial, RAM, Storage, Color, and Brand Parsers
steps.description: Added pattern matchers for S/N, SN, Serial No, RAM, Memory, ROM, Storage, and Color/Colour with boundary checks.

steps.title: Implement Multi-Angle Image Rotation OCR Decoding
steps.description: Integrated multi-angle text extraction passes (0, 90, 180, 270 degrees) for landscape, portrait, and angled box labels.

steps.title: Implement Non-Overwriting Logic for Form Controls
steps.description: Updated product entry workflow in MainActivity to ensure uncertain or empty OCR values do not overwrite manually entered text.

steps.title: Verify Offline Tesseract Processing and SQLite Integration
steps.description: Ensured offline OCR execution without external API dependencies and verified SQLite database compatibility.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Compatibility and Build Constraints
steps.description: Checked for Java 8 anonymous inner class usage and Temurin 17 AGP build rules.

steps.title: Building Box Stock Manager
steps.description: Compile release APK with enhanced OCR label recognition, Luhn IMEI verification, and non-overwriting product entry.
